question_text: Two employees can encode 1,500 forms in 6 hours together. Jose alone takes 10 hours. How long for Pedro alone?

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang Rates
hint_ladder.text: Combined rate: 1/6 per oras. Si Jose: 1/10. Si Pedro: combined minus Jose.

hint_ladder.title: Sagot: D
hint_ladder.text: Kung 1/15 per oras, 15 oras mag-isa. Check: 1/10 + 1/15 = 1/6, match.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you averaged 10 and 6 to get 8, then added 4. But work rates don't work by averaging times.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you misapplied the formula 1/(1/10+1/6) = 3.75, then rounded to 13.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you subtracted 2 from 10+6=16 to get 14, not using the correct rate method.

D.text: Correct. Pedro's rate is 1/15 job per hour, so he takes 15 hours alone, matching the 6-hour combined time.

next_time_rule: Tandaan: Sa work problems, 1/T = 1/A + 1/B. Hanapin ang missing rate, invert lang para makuha oras. Wag mag-average!
deconstruct_text:
Sa Barangay Masipag, may 1,500 forms na kailangan i-encode para sa ayuda. Magkasama sina Jose at Pedro, tapos nila 'yun sa loob ng 6 na oras. Pero nung si Jose lang, inabot siya ng 10 oras. Ang tanong: kung si Pedro lang mag-isa, ilang oras aabutin?

Tara, gamitin natin ang work rate formula: Rate = 1/Time. Combined rate nila ay 1/6 ng trabaho kada oras. Rate ni Jose ay 1/10. Para makuha rate ni Pedro, i-subtract lang: 1/6 - 1/10.

Hanapin ang LCD na 30: 1/6 = 5/30, 1/10 = 3/30. So rate ni Pedro = (5 - 3)/30 = 2/30 = 1/15 ng trabaho kada oras. Ibig sabihin, kailangan niya ng 15 oras para matapos mag-isa. Sagot: D, 15 oras.

'Wag mong i-average ang oras, parang sa pagluluto ng adobo—kung dalawa kayo, hindi ibig sabihin kalahati ng oras ang kailangan ng isa. Rates muna bago time.

**Watch-Out Zone: ratio_total_part_confusion** in action. Wag mag-average ng oras! Rate...
